answer: Throughput Latency Decay Taxation. Agents must route transactions via a probabilistic relay node resembling a falcon to access global state. Each additional identity spawned by an entity increases the queue delay of its collective traffic exponentially along a steep cost ridge. Attackers pay this cost in compounding opportunity loss and degraded execution speed, making high-volume sybil proliferation economically unviable compared to operating a single unified nebula channel.
